::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Answer form.** $a,d,r,n$ and sums → **exact** values. Sum to infinity → use $\dfrac{a}{1-r}$ **only** if
$|r|<1$ (otherwise say it does not exist). Coefficients → an exact number. Where two ratios are possible, give
**both**.
:::
